rows.question: How many days of compassionate leave do I get if my father passes away?
rows.rewritten: How many days of compassionate leave are entitled upon the passing of a parent?
rows.answer: Yes, you get 3 working days of compassionate leave if your father passes away [POL-02 §5.1].

rows.question: By what time must I tell my manager that I am taking sick leave?
rows.rewritten: What is the required timeframe for notifying my supervisor of my intention to utilize sick leave?
rows.answer: 1. You must inform your manager before 10:00 on the first day of sick leave [POL-02 §3.4].

rows.question: I am still on probation. Can I claim the home office allowance?
rows.rewritten: As a probationary employee, am I eligible to claim the work from home allowance?
rows.answer: No. The home office allowance is available after confirmation of employment, which typically means after the probation period [POL-03 §4.2].

rows.question: My expense claim is exactly RM 2,000. Who approves it?
rows.rewritten: Who approves expense claims totaling exactly RM 2,000?
rows.answer: 1. The claim of RM 2,000 is approved by the employee's direct manager [POL-04 §2.1].

rows.question: What is the nightly hotel cap in a Tier 1 city?
rows.rewritten: What is the nightly hotel cap in a Tier 1 city according to the company policy handbook?
rows.answer: The nightly hotel cap in a Tier 1 city is RM 450 [POL-05 §2.3].

rows.question: How long does the company keep the records of job candidates who were not hired?
rows.rewritten: What is the company's policy regarding the retention period of non-hired job candidates' records?
rows.answer: According to the policy, recruitment records of unsuccessful candidates are deleted after 12 months [POL-07 §3.3].

rows.question: I am a manager and want to buy equipment worth RM 30,000. What do I need to do first?
rows.rewritten: As a manager, what is the initial procedure for purchasing equipment valued at RM 30,000 according to the company policy?
rows.answer: Yes, you need three written quotations and department head approval [POL-12 §1.2].

rows.question: When is the annual bonus paid, and does someone who joined in November qualify?
rows.rewritten: When is the annual bonus distributed, and is an employee hired in November eligible for this year's bonus?
rows.answer:
1. Annual bonuses are paid in March of the following year [POL-10 §2.3].
2. Someone who joined in November does not qualify for the bonus as they did not join on or before 30 September of the performance year [POL-10 §2.4].

problems: The employee joined in November, which does not meet the condition of joining on or before 30 September of the performance year as stated in [POL-10 §2.4].

rows.question: How long can I suspend an employee on full pay during an investigation?
rows.rewritten: What is the maximum duration for placing an employee on full pay suspension during an investigation according to company policy?
rows.answer: A suspension during an investigation is on full pay and limited to 30 days [POL-11 §2.3].

rows.question: Can I claim parking and toll fees when I drive to a client meeting?
rows.rewritten: Is reimbursement for parking and toll fees during client meetings permissible?
rows.answer: Yes, you can claim parking and toll fees if you provide receipts. [POL-04 §4.3]

rows.question: my manager keeps ignoring my leave request, how long is she supposed to take to reply
rows.rewritten: How long is a manager required to respond to a leave request according to company policy?
rows.answer: 3 working days [POL-02 §2.3].

rows.question: can i plug in my own usb drive to copy some files
rows.rewritten: is it permissible to connect an external usb drive for the purpose of transferring files
rows.answer: No. USB mass storage devices are blocked by default. Exceptions need IT Security approval [POL-06 §2.3].

rows.question: turns out my brother owns a company that wants to be our vendor, what do i do
rows.rewritten: What are the procedures for handling vendor relationships when there is a personal connection?
rows.answer:
1. Declare the personal interest in writing within 14 days [POL-01 §3.2].
2. Ensure a data processing agreement is signed and the vendor passes the security assessment [POL-07 §5.1].

rows.question: can i claim the bus fare i pay to get to the office every day
rows.rewritten: can i claim reimbursement for daily transportation expenses related to commuting to the office
rows.answer: No. Commuting between home and the regular workplace is not reimbursable [POL-04 §4.4].

[POL-14 §1.1] Concerns about fraud, bribery, harassment, safety or other serious misconduct can be reported to ethics@meridianworks.example or the independent hotline.
[POL-14 §1.2] Reports may be made anonymously.

POL-04 Expense Claims Policy, version 2.2, effective 2025-07-01, section Approval matrix:
[POL-04 Table: Approval matrix] Claim amount (RM): Up to 2,000; Approver: Direct manager
Claim amount (RM): Above 2,000 and up to 10,000; Approver: Department head
Claim amount (RM): Above 10,000; Approver: CFO

POL-04 Expense Claims Policy, version 2.2, effective 2025-07-01, section Approval limits:
[POL-04 §2.1] Claims up to RM 2,000 are approved by the employee's direct manager.
[POL-04 §2.2] Claims above RM 2,000 and up to RM 10,000 are approved by the department head.
[POL-04 §2.3] Claims above RM 10,000 are approved by the CFO.
[POL-04 §2.4] No one may approve their own claim.

POL-03 Working Hours and Remote Work Policy, version 1.4, effective 2025-09-01, section Home office:
[POL-03 §4.1] Employees working from home must use a secure network and follow POL-06.
[POL-03 §4.2] A one time home office allowance of RM 500 is available after confirmation of employment, claimable under POL-04.
[POL-03 §4.3] Ergonomic assessments are available on request through POL-13.
